_comment: Serial multi-processor batch example. Keys beginning with an underscore are documentation only and are never passed to the model or watermark processors. EvoSeal is not included.

_field_guide.project_name: Project to generate and test. paths.srcPath must contain a matching source directory and MetaGPT recovery state.
_field_guide.paths.workspacePath: Workspace root recreated before preflight and every strength point.
_field_guide.paths.resPath: Output root for generated snapshots, Docker logs, progress JSONL, and summaries.
_field_guide.seed_probe_args: Optional WM-OFF seed preflight overrides. Zero-strength audits use each experiment's own generation arguments.
_field_guide.rng_seed: Default fixed generation seed. If omitted, seeds are sampled until WM-OFF generation and Docker validation pass.
_field_guide.wmS_config: Shared inclusive strength series. Use start/step/end with step > 0, or an explicit values array.
_field_guide.continue_on_error: Continue after an individual watermark experiment fails; WM-OFF preflight failures always stop the batch.
_field_guide.args: Shared generation arguments; experiments[i].args applies a shallow override.
_field_guide.experiments: Serial experiment definitions in execution order.

_strength_guide.wllm/sweet/ewd/stone/codeip/mcgmark: Each strength is passed as processor argument delta.
_strength_guide.waterfall: Each strength is passed as processor argument kappa.
_strength_guide.zero_strength_exact_noop: WLLM, SWEET, Fourier WATERFALL, EWD, STONE, and CodeIP with use_pda=false require exact equivalence to WM-OFF at zero strength.
_strength_guide.zero_strength_method_defined: CodeIP with use_pda=true and MCGMark may still alter logits at zero strength; differences are recorded as method-defined behavior.

wllm.ignore_repeated_bigrams: Must be false in this implementation.

sweet.ET: Entropy threshold, mapped to entropy_threshold at runtime.
sweet.ignore_repeated_bigrams: Must be false in this implementation.

waterfall.k_p: Integer frequency/index for the Fourier or Square function.
waterfall.n_gram: Context length maintained by the permutation processor.
waterfall.auto_reset: Reset continuation state when a new generation starts.
waterfall.detect_mode: Sequence restart detection: batch or row_any.

ewd.hash_key: Integer seed used to construct a reproducible greenlist.
ewd.prefix_length: Prefix tokens used for seeding and skipped before scoring.

stone.hash_key: Integer seed used to construct a reproducible greenlist.
stone.prefix_length: Prefix tokens used for seeding and skipped before scoring.
stone.watermark_on_pl: String switch selecting whether to watermark syntax tokens chosen by skipping_rule.
stone.skipping_rule: Syntax-token set: all_pl, keywords, operators, delimiters, whitespaces, or types.

codeip.use_pda: Enable the optional PDA/type processor after the message watermark.
codeip.gamma: Coefficient used by the PDA/type component and detector.
codeip.message_code_len: Encoded bit width of each integer message symbol.
codeip.encode_ratio: Target token-length multiplier for one message interval.
codeip.top_k: Candidate-token count within the message watermark component.
codeip.pda_model_path: Optional local PDA checkpoint used only when use_pda=true.

mcgmark.hash_key: Integer seed/key for the internal random process.
